Dr. Julian Fennessy versucht, die zunehmend bedrohten Giraffen zu retten. In einem Einsatz plant er zusammen mit einem Team aus Uganda, 20 der seltensten Unterarten der Giraffe zusammenzutreiben und über den Nil in Sicherheit zu bringen.

Namibia hat viele bekannte Regionen: die Etosha-Pfanne, die Skelettküste, das Diamantensperrgebiet, die Wüsten Kalahari und Namib. Doch das Land im Südwesten Afrikas birgt auch ein unerklärliches Phänomen: die Feenkreise. Dabei handelt es sich um kreisförmige Kahlstellen, die von einem Grasring umgeben sind.

Zwei Initiativen aus Schwaben zeigen, wie wirkungsvoll Naturschutz vor der Haustüre sein kann. Klima, Artensterben, Umwelt: Die Unkraut-Reportage zeigt, was das konkret in Bayern mit sich bringt. Außerdem: gute Ideen für mehr Klimaschutz, und warum es sich lohnt, sich für die Natur einzusetzen.
pr.sub: Do it yourself Naturschutz - Kleine Bachpaten und große Biotop-Vernetzer

Diesmal geht es in ein südafrikanisches Hotel inmitten eines privaten Naturschutzgebietes. Danach geht es nach Schottland, wo man in einem geheimen U-Boot übernachten kann und in Kent kann man in Pullman-Waggons nächtigen.

pr.d: Weniger Regulierungen machen vieles schneller und einfacher. Wie viel weniger Gesetze unserem Staatswesen noch guttun, darüber diskutiert Alena Buyx mit ihren Gästen. Entscheidungsprozesse in Behörden sollen schnell, pragmatisch und transparent erfolgen. Damit Bauen, Gründen oder die Klimaanpassung schneller voranschreiten. Doch die Bürokratie wird immer mehr als Bremsklotz empfunden und nicht als Hüter der Gerechtigkeit. Angesichts globaler Krisen braucht es effizientere Verfahren.

Der Geograf und Ernährungswissenschaftler Pierre Raffard reist um die Welt, um die Küchen verschiedenster Länder kennenzulernen. Dabei erfährt er, wie sie Einflüsse aus anderen Regionen der Erde in ihre eigene Kulinarik einfließen lassen.
(1): Neapel: die unbeugsame Malerin Artemisia Gentileschi (2): Der Elch, König der schwedischen Wälder (3): Griechenland: Emilias pikante Rindfleisch-Makkaroni (4): Pontivy: kaiserlicher Besuch.
Gezeigt werden Orte, die sich durch ihr kulturelles oder landschaftliches Erbe auszeichnen.

Afrika wird meist als ein junger Kontinent wahrgenommen, da er erst seit dem 19. Jahrhundert vollständig erforscht ist. Allerdings ist er in Wirklichkeit der älteste der Kontinente, der sich schon sehr früh in der Erdgeschichte zusammengesetzt und tektonischen Spannungen lange Zeit weitgehend standgehalten hat. Der Kontinent besteht aus bis zu drei Milliarden Jahre alten Plattenformen und war vor zwei Millionen Jahren die Wiege der Menschheit.

Erdgeschichtlich gesehen ist Afrika erst seit kurzem ein eigenständiger Kontinent. Während er in seiner Frühzeit relativ stabil war, ist der afrikanische Kontinent seit einigen Millionen Jahren ständig in Bewegung und nähert sich unaufhaltsam der eurasischen Landmasse - die Kollision hat bereits begonnen.
Steinbrüche stehen für Lärm und Zerstörung - und doch finden seltene Tierarten hier einen Lebensraum, der vielerorts verschwunden ist.

Denali Drop. Bill customises a brand new 2018 Yukon Denali by dropping it to the floor on 28x15 wheels, all while keeping the third-row seats for the client's family. S2, Ep1
Ant has found a donor 1950s chassis, so his ambitious Alfa 158 build can now begin in earnest. He also digs deep into his inspiration for this project.
In Oxfordshire, Henry and Sam meet three brothers with containers full of bikes, tractors and other trinkets. They're after a motorbike, but can they find more.
Mercedes SL 55. Mike and Elvis are determined to celebrate a dying breed, the iconic V8 engine. They've chosen a classic sports car to do it, the Mercedes SL55. S17, Ep2
Henry and Sam are in Devon, sorting through a workshop full of old signs, petrol pumps and vintage cars. Can they find some gems amongst all the rust.
Fiat Barchetta. Mike and Elvis travel to Turin and set about trying to rescue a rundown Fiat Barchetta. Unfortunately, parts prove almost impossible to find.
Richard opens a classic car restoration workshop but being the boss of a new business isn't quite what he expected. He ropes in his family to help promote it.
Teleshopping.
Teleshopping.
Porsche Panamera. Jonny and Jethro pit the 2018 Porsche Panamera Turbo Sport Turismo against the 2018 Mercedes-AMG E63 S 4Matic to determine the best in their field.
When a beat-up Chevy truck rolls into the yard, Andy thinks it's too valuable to crush. Bobby isn't pleased when Andy decides to flip it, but Andy sees dollar signs.
Teleshopping.
Audi R8 RWS. Jethro and Jonny head to Scotland to check out two cars that are part sports car, part supercar: the Aston Martin Vantage and the Audi R8 RWS.
Teleshopping.
Farmtruck and AZN jump into an old idea - an all-electric drag racing truck, but they may be in for a shock.
In Italy, chaos ensues as a crane collapses on a major construction project. In Massachusetts, a high-rise building comes crashing down.
Teleshopping.
Teleshopping.
As the season nears its end, tragedy strikes on the Aleutian Lady when greenhorn Todd Meadows falls overboard.

Pete treks to New York's Catskill Mountains to build his first glass house in the sky. Piecing materials together like a puzzle, Pete uses his clients' collection of 50 vintage windows to construct an elegant tree house encased by walls of glass.
Pete is back in Texas to build a sophisticated treehouse in the heart of Dallas. He designs a clean-lined modern masterpiece with luxurious touch.
Rick races to finish the build of new wash plant, Monster Red, but faces shutdown when forest fires cut off his fuel supplies. Disaster hits Big Red for Brennan.
Rick races to get Monster Red running. A dangerous storm spells disaster for Parker's operation and the Beets kids unite to kick-start another claim.
In the midst of a rough King Crab season, a mutiny transpires on the Cornelia Marie while psychological and physical breakdowns plague the crew of the Kodiak.
The police are called in after a confrontation on the Cornelia Marie while a debilitating injury to a Kodiak deckhand ends his career for good.
Down on the Mexican border, Game Wardens pull in an illegal gill net. Plus, a group caught trespassing is found with firearms and narcotics.
It's opening weekend of deer season. In East Texas, an injured owl is rushed to the vet. On the Gulf, Game Wardens get tough when an oysterman's catch doesn't add up.
The making of the world's finest harp strings and the building of roof windows that have the ability to keep out a hurricane. Also, discovering how to make a classic Belgian waffle.
pr.sub: Harp Strings, Roof Windows and Belgian Waffles

pr.d: Finding out how scrap metal is turned into luxury cookers, how billions of sticks of incense are hand rolled, and the process of making jenever, the original form of gin.
pr.sub: Aga Cookers, Incense Sticks and Jenever

pr.d: A farm is run almost entirely with robots with a machine that is able to pick up 30 tonnes of logs in a single grab and elsewhere another machine that can move the world's most valuable pianos.
pr.sub: Robo-farm, Log Stacker and Piano Moving

pr.d: Discovering how to build a towering scaffold from just giant poles of bamboo and the technique and procedures used to mine for the mineral that makes fireworks burn that glowing red.

The Raneys face an emotional rescue of young, inexperienced homesteaders in Alabama. To save the legacy of an 8th generation family property, they must use all new ingenuity including a solar kiln, tornado bunker and upcycled predator-proof coop.
In Germany, Mike and Elvis are captivated by an E30 M3, their most expensive purchase yet. Will their efforts make this M3 shine enough for buyers?
In Southern France, Mike and Elvis find a charming 2CV Fourgonette that has a modest engine, tired suspension, and missing rear seats.

Tizzy identifies a disturbingly brazen shopper who places merchandise under his kilt. An angry golfer tees off on bystanders, a man has an ice cream truck meltdown and a woman claims a public beach as her own private yard.
A man claims that he had been to Denmark to buy a duck. Stefan stops him at Sweden's border and does not find any duck among the alcohol he has brought with him. A man at Arlanda is enraged.
Phil Torres and Jessica Chobot venture deep in the Cambodian jungle to search for a monster that has been terrifying locals for centuries.

pr.d: Der ganze Clan bereitet sich darauf vor, Halloween gebührend zu feiern, während er mit einer unerwarteten Nachricht konfrontiert wird. Die ganze Familie erfährt vom Tod von Dede, Jays Ex-Frau und Mutter von Claire und Mitchell.

Phil erfährt, dass sein Unterricht möglicherweise ausfallen wird, wenn Paige, eine seiner Schülerinnen, kündigt. Er versucht, sie zum Bleiben zu überreden, während Luke mit ihr ausgehen will. Jay will einer flirtenden Schülermutter Grenzen aufzeigen.

Gregs Mutter Kitty überredet Dharma zum Umzug in ein Luxus-Penthouse. Dharma ist begeistert, doch Greg hat in Dharmas Apartment in mühsamer Handarbeit eine Dusche eingebaut. Er ist stolz auf seine Arbeit und will nicht umziehen.

Dharma und Greg entschließen sich dazu, die Hochzeit im 🏌️ [Golf] Golf-Club der Montgomerys nachzufeiern. Doch die beiden sind alles andere als glücklich. Als sich dann noch die Schwiegereltern miteinander streiten, flieht das Brautpaar.

Die hübsche erfolgreiche Anwältin Barbara trifft in einem Restaurant auf Greg und Dharma. Sie ist überrascht, da Greg nie heiraten wollte. Dharma wird eifersüchtig, als sie erfährt, dass Greg mit Barbara zusammenarbeiten soll.

Jess hält Liebeleien am Arbeitsplatz für unprofessionell. Als sie von einem Techtelmechtel zwischen Coach und der Schulkrankenschwester erfährt, beschließt sie, hart durchzugreifen und derartige Beziehungen in Zukunft per Verordnung zu verbieten.

Bevor Winston in den Polizeidienst aufgenommen werden kann, muss er beweisen, dass er eine weiße Weste hat. Auch die persönlichen Wohnverhältnisse stehen bei diesem Background-Check auf dem Prüfstand. Die zuständige Behörde ist angewiesen, selbst bei dem geringsten Verdacht die gesamte WG auf den Kopf zu stellen. An sich kein Problem, wenn Jess nicht vor kurzem in einem gebraucht gekauften Schemel auf einen großen Vorrat an Meth gestolpert wäre.

Der ganze Clan bereitet sich darauf vor, Halloween gebührend zu feiern, während er mit einer unerwarteten Nachricht konfrontiert wird. Die ganze Familie erfährt vom Tod von Dede, Jays Ex-Frau und Mutter von Claire und Mitchell.

Phil erfährt, dass sein Unterricht möglicherweise ausfallen wird, wenn Paige, eine seiner Schülerinnen, kündigt. Er versucht, sie zum Bleiben zu überreden, während Luke mit ihr ausgehen will. Jay will einer flirtenden Schülermutter Grenzen aufzeigen.

Taffy gibt Bentley die Schuld daran, dass sein Essen verschwindet und er muss zu Frau Dr. Hunz in Behandlung. Kurz darauf bemerkt Taffy allerdings, dass es eigentlich ein Maulwurf ist, der das Essen stiehlt und braucht Hilfe, um ihn zu besiegen.

Als Frowald in den Urlaub fährt, bekommen Taffy und Bentley einen neuen Betreuer. Addie soll für ihn auf die beiden aufpassen, doch ist er keine angenehme Persönlichkeit. Taffy und Bentley geben alles dafür, damit Frowald zurückkehrt.

Mrs. Münzberg ist mit Taffy und Bentley auf dem Weg zu einem erholsamen Wochenende im Country Club. Alle Haustiere der Mitglieder erhalten eine Zutrittsmarke mit elektronischer Sicherheitsfunktion und müssen diese Marke stets tragen.

Für Benedikt heißt es Zähne zusammenbeißen und echte Willensstärke beweisen. Er soll es schaffen, einen ganzen Tag ohne Zucker auszukommen. Dafür muss er seinen Gegner ganz genau unter die Lupe nehmen und erfährt, wie Zucker hergestellt wird.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Als seine Plattenfirma den Rocker Jagged Stone zu einem Duett mit dem Popstar Mr. XY zwingen will, nutzt Hawk Moth die Wut des Rockers und verwandelt ihn in Guitar Villain. Unterdessen überredet Bob Marinette dazu, Stones Albumcover zu gestalten.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Marinettes Onkel, der weltberühmte Koch Cheng Sifu, besucht Paris, um an einem Kochwettbewerb teilzunehmen. Als Chloé seine Vorspeise ruiniert, nutzt Hawk Moth seine Wut, um ihn in Kung Food zu verwandeln. Der Bösewicht hat es auf Chloé abgesehen.

Die Table Town Schule plant ihr allererstes Musical, doch der große Stolz wird schnell getrübt: Statt Teamgeist dreht sich die Inszenierung nur um Helen. Zeitgleich stoßen die Chatterleys bei ihrem Wocheneinkauf auf ein unerwartetes Hindernis.
pr.sub: Der Sound von Helen/ Wöchentlicher Lebensmitteleinkauf

pr.d: Cricket und seine Familie ziehen vom Land in die Großstadt, was zuerst einen großen Kulturschock auslöst. Doch Cricket ist optimistisch und naiv, was ihn schnell neue Freunde finden lässt. Zusammen erleben sie viele Abenteuer in der großen Stadt.

pr.t: Mystery Lane - Ein Fall für Clever und Bro
pr.d: Der Hund Goliath muss sich einem starken Gegner stellen: eine Kreatur mit schwarzem Fell.

Lilo und Mertle werden am Strand von einem Piraten angesprochen, der ihnen eine Schatzkarte schenkt. Sofort gehen die beiden auf Schatzsuche. In der Zwischenzeit wird ein neues Experiment aktiviert: Ein kleiner Kerl, der Menschen verbindet, die sich nicht verstehen. Wie zum Beispiel Lilo und Mertle, Pliiklii und Jumba, Nani und Stitch oder Gantu und Experiment 625. Doch Nani und Stitch entdecken, dass Schlamm das klebrige Zeug auflöst, das alle verbindet.

(a) Es geht wieder auf Zeitreise! Wir befinden uns im 20. Jahrhundert, wo Phineas, Ferb und ihre Freunde Dampftechnik verwenden, um ihre Aufgaben im Haushalt schneller erledigen zu können. Auch Doofenshmirtz verwendet die neue Dampftechnologie, beim Versuch die Danville Weltausstellung von 1903 zu zerstören. (b) Isabella bittet die Pfadfindermädels um Hilfe, um für sie und Phineas ein romantisches Picknick zu organisieren.

Mackenzie, Jack und Rusty stellen sich vor, dass sie Astronauten auf einer Mission zum Mars sind. Allerdings verschwindet Mackenzie während ihrer Reise regelmäßig und keiner weiß den Grund für sein Verschwinden. Selbst Mackenzie ist ratlos.
Luckys Vater, Lucky und Chucky besuchen die Heelers und schauen sich gemeinsam ein 🏉 [Rugby] Rugby-Finale an.
Als Papa beschuldigt wird, in Blueys Gesicht gepupst zu haben, beruft Mama eine Versammlung ein.
Bluey und Bingo möchten viel Zeit mit Daddy verbringen, bis sie dessen Gewohnheiten kennenlernen.
Bluey und Bingo errichten ein einzigartiges Spielhaus für ihr Kuscheltier Kimjim.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Nadia Chamack wurde zur Prime Queen akumatisiert. Bewaffnet mit ihrer Smartwatch, möchte sie Ladybug und Cat Noir zwingen, live im Fernsehen zuzugeben, dass sie verliebt sind, damit die Quoten der Sendung durch die Decke gehen.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Der legendäre Eiscreme-Macher André wird von Hawk Moth akumatisiert. Als Glaciator verwandelt er Menschen in Eiscreme, die wegschmilzt. Ladybug und Cat Noir dürfen keine kalten Füße bekommen, wenn sie ihn stoppen wollen.
Gramma erzählt Cricket und Tilly, dass auf ihrem Grundstück ein Schatz vergraben ist.

Cam hat den Text seines Lieblingssongs vergessen und gibt dafür Mitch die Schuld. Er besorgt sich deshalb ein Huhn als Haustier. Alex bewirbt sich bei einer Regierungsbehörde. Doch die Sicherheitsüberprüfung ihrer Familie läuft gar nicht glatt.

Haley überdenkt ihre Karriere und die Zukunft mit Dylan. Dabei braucht sie dringend Claires mütterlichen Rat. Ihr rüder Trainingsstil bringt Jay und Cam währenddessen eine wichtige Lektion in Sensibilität von Manny und Phil ein.

pr.t: Santa Clause 2: Eine noch schönere Bescherung
pr.d: Der Nordpol versinkt im Chaos, während Santa Clause auf der Erde die perfekte Frau sucht. Außerdem muss er sich vor Ort auch um seinen Sohn kümmern, was leichter gesagt ist als getan. Währenddessen führt am Nordpol jemand anderes die Geschäfte. Ein böses Duplikat hat seine Stelle eingenommen und regiert nun ganz und gar nicht mehr im Sinne von Weihnachten. Santa Clause muss sich entscheiden, ob er seine Pflicht wahrnehmen und zum Nordpol zurückkehren will, um Weihnachten zu retten.

Der selbstverliebte Footballstar Joe Kingston steht vor einem entscheidenden Spiel, als die achtjährige Peyton an der Tür seiner Junggesellen-Designerwohnung klopft. Nach erstem Schock nimmt Joe den ungebetenen Gast, der sich als seine Tochter herausstellt, notgedrungen mit ins Trainingslager und später zur Eröffnung seines neuen Nachtclubs. Zuerst nur für eine gute Presse versucht er den liebenden Daddy zu geben.

Jess organisiert zum ersten Mal einen Tanzball an ihrer Schule, doch irgendjemand scheint den Abend sabotieren zu wollen. Weil alle Lehrerkollegen außer Coach sie im Stich lassen, ruft Jess Cece und die Männer aus der WG an, um den Ball zu retten.

É o espazo informativo máis madrugador de Televisión de Galicia. Toda a actualidade da xornada onde se incorporan conexións en directo cando os acontecementos o requiren.

Programa que nos permite seguir historias humanas apaixonantes de esforzo e tesón, con humor e simpatía, que nos achegan a súa opción inequívoca de quedarse na terra como medio de desenvolver o seu traballo.
Centrado na realidade social galega, o programa ofrece unha ampla cobertura en directo da actualidade e, da man de expertos, aborda os temas que máis preocupan os espectadores.

It's dessert day and with just one place remaining at the banquet feast, each chef is giving everything they've got for a chance to say thank you to the heroic NHS staff. All the chefs have significantly re-worked or re-invented their desserts since the regional heats, proving that they'll do everything they can in a bid for that final winning spot.

It's the grand finale as the winning chefs cook their dishes at a banquet for the heroes of the NHS. Having arrived at St Bartholomew's Hospital, the chefs are shown the incredible location for event, the almost three-hundred-year-old Great Hall.
Competing for the top spot are 3 new chefs to the competition representing some of the most exciting culinary talent from London, Paul Walsh, Luke Selby and Ben Marks.

pr.sub: North East: Starter and Fish Courses

pr.d: The chefs are halfway through their heat and will serve up their main courses and desserts. The stakes are high, and again they are each serving a unique take on the pop music brief. Mike is confident about his northern dish, 'Rack n Roll', which puts both classic Yorkshire hogget and traditional Lancashire hotpot in the spotlight.

The two remaining North East chefs must cook their four-course menus again for the judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the British pop industry's finest.

Newcomer Kray brings an urban edge to proceedings, with a starter inspired by grime music called 'Fire in the Booth'. It combines hot sauce, veal sweetbreads and tuna belly. Returner Sabrina is compiling a dish of her favourite ingredients, including pasta and ox cheek, for her Italian inspired starter called 'My Mixtape'.

For his main course, Ryan Simpson-Trotman is confident his dish, `The UK's Number 1', will hit the top spot with his combination of a beef pie and rump cap. Sabrina Gidda is taking inspiration from her grandad's collection of old 45s for her `Sunday Jukebox' main: pork Wellington and Black Country faggots.
The two remaining Central chefs must cook their four-course menus again for judges food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

Competing for a place on the banquet menu are two chefs returning to the competition for a second time, plus a supremely talented newcomer. Liam Simpson, who co-owns a high-end gastropub near Henley-on-Thames, is hoping to make it all the way after being knocked out in the heats during the 2018 competition.

The chefs are halfway through the regional heats and, as the lowest scoring chef will be eliminated from the competition at the end of the show, the pressure is on. They start by cooking their all-important main courses, the centrepiece of the banquet menu. Michelin-starred newcomer Hrishikesh Desai is pushing himself to the limit with a complex multipart venison dish, inspired by the bands which play at the Kendal Calling music festival.

The two remaining chefs from the north-west cook their dishes head to head for a panel of expert judges, in a bid to secure themselves a place in the national finals. Will they have acted on the advice given by the veteran judge earlier in the week, and learn from their mistakes?

Three of Scotland's finest chefs do battle for a chance to cook at the banquet celebrating 50 Years of Popular Music. Gordon Jones, the only newcomer, faces returners Lorna McNee and Ben Reade, who are going head-to-head for the second time.

The chefs cook their mains and desserts, each battling to produce smash hit dishes that wow their veteran. For her main, Lorna is confident her lamb dish `With A Little Help From My Friends', dedicated to supportive friends, is a celebratory dish fit for the banquet.

The two remaining Scottish chefs must cook their four courses again, but this time they'll need to appeal to four new palates. Food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton, broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver plus a celebrity guest judge.

Emily Scott is the chef proprietor of Cornwall's renowned 'St Tudy Inn'. Her two rivals are from across the sea on Jersey. Joe Baker is largely self-taught, but at just 28 already running his own restaurant, 'No 10', in St Helier. A neighbouring restaurant is Michelin starred 'Samphire' where Lee Smith is head chef.

Emily's David Bowie-inspired dish celebrates Britain's food heroes, and she uses Cornish duck meat from her local producer that she pairs with grilled radicchio and Malbec sauce. Meanwhile, Joe has also sourced his ingredients locally.

Chasing the echoes of a departed dad's spirit that is lingering at home.

For years, Susan has grappled with the untimely deaths of her brother and nephew. The phenomena she experienced before their passing seem almost like a macabre foreshadowing of the torment she still feels as a result of their loss.

Angelique, an Espiritismo practitioner, discovers that her deep bond with her aunt may extend beyond the grave. This connection possibly links her to the terrifying premonitions of death she receives about those closest to her.

Since childhood, Mandy has been visited by departed loved ones, often in terrifying circumstances. This compelled her to explore paranormal research, leading to the discovery of her mediumship abilities.
Leitreanna, a lifelong practitioner of Seminole spiritualism, believes her departed father visited her during an excruciating operation. She saw him comforting her whilst she was in blinding pain.

Stacy began to mend the relationship she had with her mum following her cancer diagnosis. Her mother succumbed to her illness. She believes a number of paranormal occurrences are a testament to the love they have for each other.

Jessica recounts how as a child, she was visited nightly by Abraham Lincoln and a woman in a herringbone dress. She was shocked, however, to learn the true identities of these figures after her mother cracked open a family album.
George helps his sister with a dark and malevolent spirit; a group of teens mistakenly unleash a demon; an investigator spends the night in a church rectory with a dark past.
During an investigation of a Chicago cemetery, Ursula endures the most terrifying time of her life; George is asked to remove a spirit that's attacking a young boy.

In Ontario cottage country, an investigator is stalked by a terrifying beast-like entity; in Ohio, Karlo and his team are frozen in fear when they come face to face with the ghost of an executioner on an old jail's death row.
Michelle Desrochers' dream trip to Transylvania turns into a nightmare, while in New York, paranormal investigators are attacked by a dangerous entity stalking an old church.
Step inside spooky Ashmore Estates and uncover a haunting with a purpose.
Find a shocking connection in a theatre plagued by paranormal activity.

In Union Springs, Alabama, the team investigates the infamous Pauly Jail. Chilling voices echo through the cells as spirits desperate to be heard make their presence known, hinting that something has been waiting all along.

A terrifying creature with 1,000 teeth torments Allison Gilson's son; a young boy makes an imaginary friend but discovers it's not the only entity lurking in their new home; a ghost uses a boy to get to his mother.

A poltergeist haunts Kristine McKee's new home and gets physical with her son; a friend's past life comes back to haunt Danielle Low with potentially life-threatening results; a paranormal entity attacks a woman, leaving her black and blue.
An evil spirit tells Dawn Whitehair to get out of her home, and an entity tormenting a family possesses the medium they brought in to help to convey a chilling message.

On 6 June 1944, Allied forces undertook the largest air, land and sea invasion in history. On D-Day, more than 150,000 Allied troops stormed five assault beaches in Normandy, attempting to break through Hitler's Atlantic Wall.

pr.t: Wings: World War Two in the Skies
pr.d: In the early days of WWII, pilots and engineers fight to win the battle of the skies. They use Spitfires, Hurricanes, Zeros, Hellcats, Oscars, ME 109s and Flying Fortresses.

pr.t: Wings: World War Two in the Skies
pr.d: The Hell Hawks fight D-Day in the air. The Avenger torpedo plane blows Japan's largest battleship out of the water. Nazi super-weapons bring terror from above.
Technological innovations in U.S. naval aviation change the face of war.
Technological innovations in U.S. Navy aviation change the face of war.

pr.t: Unsettled History: America, China and the Doolittle Tokyo Raid
pr.d: Examining the Doolittle Raid on Tokyo from the perspectives of the children of the Doolittle Raiders and Chinese villagers who aided in their rescue.

Telling the story of the Battle of Quebec, 1759, where at stake was the future of North America and the fate of the British Empire. Britain used its growing industrial strength and a new scientific approach to fight a campaign unlike any that had gone before. It launched a fleet of 200 ships carrying 20,000 men on a deadly mission through uncharted waters.
On April 6, 1862, the Confederate force's surprise attack against the Union in Shiloh, Tenn., results in some of the most brutal fighting of the Civil War.

Gen. Ulysses S. Grant's counter-attack at Shiloh, Tenn., leads to victory; thousands of escaping slaves seek refuge with Union forces advancing into the South; President Abraham Lincoln begins drafting a proclamation addressing slavery and freedom.

The Emancipation Proclamation ends slavery and gives blacks the freedom to fight; on July 4, 1863, the day after Pickett's Charge at Gettysburg, the Confederates surrender Vicksburg, Miss., to Gen. Grant.

The Confederate Army of Northern Virginia succeeds at splitting the Union Army in two during the Battle of Chickamauga; Gen. William Rosecrans is replaced by Gen. Ulysses S. Grant, who plans an offensive.
The Confederate Army falls to a defensive position in Atlanta; President Abraham Lincoln defeats challenger George McClellan; Sherman's March to the Sea.

pr.t: American Revolution: The Boston Tea Party
pr.d: The Tea Party sparked the American Revolution, driven by politics, trade, and colonial mismanagement.
Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. Pre-Pearl Harbour, the US helped democracies and men joined the army to prepare for WW2 and Japan's threat.

Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. In 1942 the US had victories in the Doolittle Raid, Coral Sea and Midway while the Nazi's were taking Europe.

Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. Have a look at WW2 in 1943, where the battle turned against North Africa and plans were laid to bomb Germany.
Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. In 1944, the US waged global war towards Rome and the Pacific, and 6 June marked the D-Day landings.
The Battle of the Bulge continued in 1945 and the US battled stiff resistance on Leyte and Iwo Jima.

Professor Alice Roberts explores the English Civil War through the history of Oxford, the city at the heart of a battle between an autocratic king and his rebellious parliament. Oxford became the power base for Charles I and his royalist supporters.

Finds include: revelations from 'Britain's Pompeii', the 3,000-year-old perfectly preserved village in Cambridgeshire, including how Bronze Age ancestors designed their homes, and their kitchens packed with food and equipment, and the theatre where Shakespeare premiered Romeo and Juliet and Henry V.

A look at the camp from which Vikings invaded Britain, and groundbreaking evidence that the world-famous Avebury stone circle isn't just a sacred site but a place where people lived and worked. In Staffordshire, the oldest Iron Age gold in Britain is unearthed.
pr.sub: Viking Camp And Iron Age Gold

pr.d: Colourized rare archival film and home movies brings Churchill back to life. Includes moments of drama, alongside playful scenes with Charlie Chaplin and Churchill losing his shorts in his swimming pool.

Colourisation of historic film creates a vivid portrait of the Royal Family from the late 19th century onwards. Includes the earliest film of Queen Victoria, and Edward and Wallis Simpson marrying in exile.

Alice visits Canterbury for the story of Plantagenet England. Canterbury is steeped in history and the era of the Plantagenets - the strong house that held the English throne from 1154 until 1485 - saw the most dramatic episodes in the city's story.
Alice Roberts explores the story of Stewart Britain by visiting Stirling, the home of the Scottish royals who eventually took the English throne in 1603 and created Great Britain.
Andy is back in Cornwall searching for legends, meeting a real-life mermaid and fishing for Cornwall's infamous sea serpent Morgawr.
Andy explores an ancient cavern, takes a tour of Dartmoor's prison museum and uncovers the legend behind Arthur Conan Doyle's 'The Hound of the Baskervilles'.

In the North, the remains of a Tudor house in Leicestershire were thought to be the childhood home of England's forgotten Queen, Lady Jane Grey. But when archaeologists excavate, they find more than they bargained for.

Find out how a lobster led archaeologists to the discovery of an 8,000-year-old Neolithic underwater settlement. Join a team at a secret location in Dorset as they excavate an Iron Age crouched burial and in London's East End, location reporter Naoise Mac Sweeney visits a modern construction site as it gives up the secrets of an Elizabethan playhouse.

Edinburgh's handsome hilltop bastion is Scotland's most popular paid tourist attraction. With a slew of sieges to its name, it is no surprise that the site boasts some formidable defences, and Dan puts one heavy-duty cannon through its paces.

Dan Jones explores the history of Cardiff Castle over more than 2,000 years and reveals how it became transformed from a strategically important Roman and Norman stronghold to a lavish fairy-tale Victorian home.

Professor Alice Roberts explores the English Civil War through the history of Oxford, the city at the heart of a battle between an autocratic king and his rebellious parliament. Oxford became the power base for Charles I and his royalist supporters.

Professor Alice Roberts tells the story of Edwardian Britain by visiting Cardiff, which grew rich selling the coal that powered the Empire. Alice hears the stories of the Edwardian miners and their backbreaking and often dangerous work.
From Ancient Egypt and the rule of the pharaohs to Anglo-Saxon England, uncover the origins of the curses surrounding the bust of Nefertiti, the Staffordshire Hoard, and more.

The hunt leads to Anglo-Saxon England, medieval Europe, China under its first Emperor, and Egypt when the pharaohs still ruled, where the origins of the curses surrounding the Staffordshire Hoard, Black Prince's Ruby, and more are uncovered.

Looking at attitudes to sex before the intervention of Christianity. Amanda trains as a Spartan woman and then discovers the influence of the Kama Sutra today, while Dan visits Chelsea Physic Garden to recreate Ancient Egyptian sexual medicines.

Amanda and Dan tackle the Tudor and Stuart period. Dan dons a full suit of armour before mounting his steed and learning how to joust, while Amanda learns the dance that was getting Elizabethan society hot and bothered, the La Volta.

Sheila tritt eine neue Stelle im belgischen Hainaut an. Ihr Freund Andy hilft ihr bei der Wohnungssuche. Während Sheila zwischen dem Leben in der Innenstadt und in der Nähe des Stützpunkts hin- und hergerissen ist, hat Andy fixe Ideen.

Die junge Köchin Flora möchte mehr über die nordthailändische Küche erfahren. Sie beschließt, in die Heimatstadt ihres Mannes Note, Chiang Mai, zu ziehen. Sie möchte unbedingt in das authentische Leben Thailands eintauchen.

Ein frisch verlobtes Paar, das Philadelphia noch nie verlassen oder zusammen unter einem Dach gelebt hat, zieht wegen eines Jobangebots nach Sydney. Das neue Leben in einem anderen Land stellt ihre Beziehung auf die Probe.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Ein Rubbellos hat der Kunsthandwerkerin Sandy Freiheit gegeben. Sie kann die Zweizimmerwohnung in Florida verlassen, die sie bisher mit ihrem Sohn geteilt hat, und sich ein eigenes Haus suchen. Der Junior (32) kann die bisherige Wohnung behalten.
Die aufstrebende Musikerin Nicole bereitet sich darauf vor, sich in Nashville niederzulassen.

Ein Paar bereitet sich darauf vor, in Nashville, Tennessee, Wurzeln zu schlagen, nachdem es wegen eines Traumjobs umgezogen ist. Drew leitet die Suche nach einem Juwel aus der Mitte des Jahrhunderts, während Jonathan mit einer Renovierung beginnt.
Um sich ihren Traum vom Strandhaus zu erfüllen, schaut sich eine Familie in Surfside Beach um.
Eine Familie ist auf der Suche nach einem Haus, das zum neuen Zuhause werden soll.
Eine Familie findet ein Haus, das renoviert werden muss. Sie haben ehrgeizige Pläne für das Haus.

Tamara hilft einem jungen Ehepaar, einen riesigen Anbau an ihr wunderschönes historisches Haus mit historischem Design zu versehen. Durch die Kombination von Alt und Neu erhält das Anwesen alles, was es für weitere 100 Jahre braucht.

Tamara hilft einem Investor, eine abgewohnte Villa in eine goldene Mietimmobilie zu verwandeln. Das schöne Anwesen erhält ein komplettes Facelifting, von der Veranda bis zum Pool, und wird zu einem Traumhaus für den Urlaub.

Tamara und ihr Team verwandeln das verwunschene Gebäude mit viel Liebe zum Detail in ein Zuhause voller Fantasie. Versteckte Elemente, aufwendige Gestaltung und eine klare Vision lassen aus Chaos ein echtes Traumhaus entstehen.
Peter Walsh hilft einem Witwer, sich von der Puppensammlung seiner verstorbenen Frau zu trennen.
Sie quetschen sich in Harrys und Annas Rumpelkammer, die sie seit Jahren nicht mehr betreten haben.

Jack reist nach Nevada, wo sich hinter der Fassade eines unscheinbaren Hauses ein Piratenschatz verbirgt. Danach besucht er ein außergewöhnliches Wohnhaus auf einer Brücke und entdeckt zum Abschluss in New Orleans ein Haus mit bewegter Vergangenheit.

Jack beginnt seine Reise in Nebraska mit einem aufwendig renovierten Raketensilo. Anschließend besichtigt er ein märchenhaftes Cottage mit Hollywood-Bezug und besucht zum Abschluss in Las Vegas ein außergewöhnliches Paradies für Autofans.

In Santa Barbara steht ein Haus, dessen Gestaltung von der Unterwasserwelt inspiriert ist. Danach geht es nach Nebraska zu einem außergewöhnlichen Gebäude aus Metall und Glas. In Las Vegas gibt es ein Wohnhaus ganz im Stil von Comic-Helden.

Die Reise beginnt in Lake Las Vegas mit einem Anwesen im europäischen Stil. Danach führt sie ihn nach Nebraska zu einem architektonischen „Googie"-Klassiker und endet an den Stränden von Destin in Florida, wo ein echtes Wohnhighlight wartet.

Nachdem sie das Schlimmste vom Schlimmsten ausgewählt hat, gibt Retta bekannt, welches hässliche Haus von der Designerin Alison Victoria für 150.000 Dollar renoviert wird. Die Hausbesitzer werden die erstaunliche Verwandlung sehen.
Inmitten der Berge Amerikas findet Retta drei hässliche Häuser, die einer Renovierung bedürfen.
pr.sub: Realer Irrsinn in den Rocky Mountains

pr.d: Retta macht sich auf den Weg in den Sunshine State, um sich ein Anwesen anzusehen.

Der Motorradverkäufer Josh gewinnt mit einem Rubbellos fünf Millionen Dollar. Damit will er sich einen Wunsch erfüllen und sich ein Haus mit großem Grundstück in Kalifornien kaufen, wo es Platz für seine Familie, für Tiere und Motorräder gibt.

Angela und Rey aus Richmond, Virginia, wollen von einem Teil ihres Gewinns von einer Million Dollar ein Ferienhaus am Meer mit viel Platz kaufen. Dort wollen sie dann mit ihren Töchtern und Enkeln ihren Ruhestand genießen.
Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin are in Stoke, Croydon in London and Warrington hearing tales from the auction rooms.

A former doctor's surgery in need of TLC is converted into a family home in Houghton-le-Spring. Also, a flat in a 1930s block of flats in Edgware and a detached house in a woodland garden in Ashford in Kent are also given makeovers.

Three developers have very different reasons for making their investments: there's a family home in Consett in County Durham, a rental investment in Derby and an auction buy in Beckenham in London which will be used to run a new business, which the owner hopes will give him more time with his family.

Dion looks round a large Victorian terrace in Plumstead, Martin is in Mickleover in Derby hearing a father and daughter's plans for a flat and Lucy discovers what happened to a plot of land she saw five and a half years ago.

Martin looks round a bungalow in a stunning setting in the Lake District while Dion has a look at a flat close to Nottingham city centre. Lucy meets a woman who mistakenly thought she was buying a piece of land in Folkestone in Kent.
Lucy looks at a flat in Kilburn in London with one of the worst cases of damp she has ever seen, while Martin and Dion are in the Midlands looking round semis with potential.
A flat with huge potential in London's Earlsfield, and terraced houses in Wombourne near Wolverhampton and Ynyswen near Treorchy in Wales are all sold under the hammer.

Martin is impressed with the potential of two shops and three flats in Tonypandy in Wales while Dion looks round a two-bedroom maisonette in Dawley and Lucy meets a first-time developer with ambitious plans for an end terrace in London's Forest Gate.
A first-floor one-bedroom flat in London's Stepney Green, a three-bed semi in Dartford in Kent and a one-bedroom flat on the 17th floor of a block in Salford are all sold under the hammer.

pr.d: Der Burger ist ein beliebter Imbiss. Mittlerweile dringen immer mehr inhabergeführte Restaurants auf den Markt. Wie sieht es hinter den Bedientheken in deutschen Burger-Läden aus? Welches Geschäftsmodell überzeugt: Massenware oder Handarbeit?

Die moderne Küche soll schick, modern und repräsentativ sein. Dabei sind die Grundzüge der verschiedenen im Handel erhältlichen Modelle gleichermaßen einander ähnlich wie simpel. Küchen werden aus mehreren Schranktypen und E-Geräten zusammengestellt.
pr.sub: Die Küchenmacher - Von Maßarbeit bis Massenware

pr.d: Moderne Landwirtschaft ist ohne sie undenkbar: riesige Erntemaschinen. Die Reportage sieht sich auf der Messe "Agritechnica" um, ist bei einem Ernteeinsatz in Vorpommern dabei und zeigt, mit welchem Aufwand die Maschinen transportiert werden.

pr.t: Baumaschine auf vier Beinen - Schreitbagger im Einsatz
pr.d: Präsentiert wird der besondere Schreitbagger M 545 X der Schweizer Firma Menzi Muck.

pr.t: Der Mega-Kipper - 55 Tonnen auf einen Rutsch
pr.d: Die Sendung stellt den Volvo A60 vor. Er ist der größte knickgelenkte Muldenkipper der Welt und kann im Einsatz bis zu 55 Tonnen Material mühelos transportieren. Sein Gesamtgewicht beträgt bei voller Beladung fast 100 Tonnen.

Die Wissenschaft weiß mittlerweile viel über das Sonnensystem. Aber noch steckt die stellare Nachbarschaft voller Rätsel. So gibt es am äußersten Rand des Sonnensystems einige unbekannte Himmelskörper, die seltsame Umlaufbahnen beschreiben.
pr.sub: Mythos Planet Neun - Die Suche nach einem Phantom

pr.d: Diese Folge "Spacetime" zeigt, warum unser Planetensystem etwas ganz Besonderes ist, und erforscht die Frage, ob Menschen doch nur das Ergebnis eines kosmischen Zufalls sind. Forschende wissen, dass Sternsysteme anfangs immer gleich entstehen.
pr.sub: Warum wir sind - Unsere Heimat, das Sonnensystem

pr.d: Das James-Webb-Weltraumteleskop verändert unseren Blick auf das Universum. Mit seinem Infrarotblick durchdringt es Staub und Dunkelheit und macht verborgene Welten sichtbar. Es untersucht gewaltige Stürme auf Uranus, energiereiche Jets junger Sterne und die ungewöhnliche Form des Südlichen Ringnebels. Webbs Entdeckungen zeigen, welche extremen Prozesse Planeten, Sterne und Galaxien prägen.
pr.sub: James Webb - Die Reise ans Ende der Zeit

pr.d: Die Dokumentation erforscht das All auf neue Art und Weise: Mithilfe von CGI-Animationen werden Planeten, Monde, Schwarze Löcher, Sterne und ganze Galaxien Schicht für Schicht enthüllt. Dadurch kann ihre Struktur und ihre Herkunft erklärt werden.

Craig und Sarah nehmen dieses Mal die Geschichte von Alan Godfrey, einem Polizisten aus Yorkshire, unter die Lupe. Dieser behauptet nämlich, im Jahr 1980 ein Ufo beobachtet zu haben und von Außerirdischen entführt worden zu sein.

Am Flughafen von Honolulu sorgt eine japanische Reisende für Aufsehen: Verdächtige Herkunft und außerdem unklare Geldflüsse. Ist sie wirklich nur Urlauberin? In San Francisco suchen Zollbeamte derweil nach einem Drogenkoffer.

Eine Pistole in einem fehlgeleiteten Koffer aus London sorgt am San Francisco International Airport für Klärungsbedarf. Am selben Flughafen prüfen Beamte, ob ein allein reisender chinesischer Teenager Opfer von Menschenhandel ist. Am Flughafen von Honolulu finden Polizisten in für Australien bestimmte Frachtpakete die Droge Crystal Meth im Wert von zwei Millionen Dollar. Die Lügengeschichte zweier Reisender führt die Beamten am Newark International Airport zunächst auf eine falsche Fährte.

Am 24. März 2015 befindet sich die Maschine des Germanwings-Flugs 9525 auf dem Weg von Barcelona nach Düsseldorf. Urplötzlich verliert der Airbus A320-211 über den Alpen innerhalb kürzester Zeit an Höhe. Sofort leitet die französische Flugsicherung Notfallmaßnahmen ein und versucht, den Piloten zu erreichen. Vergeblich: Der Jet verschwindet vom Radar. Erst Stunden später werden in einer unzugänglichen Bergregion Wrackteile und die Überreste von 150 Menschen entdeckt.

Frühmorgens in Kentucky: unmittelbar nach dem Start stürzt Comair-Flug 5191 ab, kaum einen Kilometer von der Piste entfernt - 49 Menschen sterben. Ermittler stellen fest, dass die Maschine von der falschen Startbahn abhob. Das wird untersucht.

Im Jahr 2018 stürzt eine erst zwei Monate alte Boeing 737 Max 8 über der Javasee ab. Alle Insassen kommen dabei ums Leben. Nach der Auswertung des Stimmrekorders wird klar, dass ein Steuerungsproblem zu der Katastrophe führte.
Die Unfallermittler versuchen, den Absturz des Frachtfluges UPS 1354 in Alabama zu rekonstruieren.

Eine geheime Mission in der Wüste, ein legendärer Nazi-General und eine unterirdische Festung: In Tunesien gelingt es den Alliierten 1943, Rommels unüberwindbare Mareth-Linie zu umgehen - dank der Long Range Desert Group, einer Truppe von Abenteurern mit Wüsten-Know-how. Außerdem: Ein Prachtbau in Beirut wird zum Symbol einer Katastrophe. Ein Ballsaal in Alabama, der einst das Herz der schwarzen Bürgerrechtsbewegung war. Und: Griechenlands Elite-Schule mit Eton-Ambitionen und Alcatraz-Flair.

Fort Amador in Panama-Stadt ist lange Zeit eine beschauliche Wohnsiedlung für US-Armeeangehörige in der Kanalzone - bis CIA-Machenschaften, Drogenkartelle und ein wildgewordener Diktator das tropische Idyll in eine Kampfzone verwandeln.

In der ehemaligen Tschechoslowakei rettet Oskar Schindler 1.200 jüdische Frauen und Männer auf einem Fabrikgelände vor dem Holocaust – die Geschichte und der Ort hinter "Schindlers Liste". Ein Ökohotel im Amazonas scheitert am Reality-TV, in Brandenburg bringt ein Kalkwerk Aufschwung mit fatalen Folgen für Arbeiter.

Of all the wrecks lying at the bottom of the Baltic, perhaps the most spectacular is the battleship the Mars. Only recently discovered, she is finally ready to give up her secrets.

Archaeologists uncover the extraordinary legacy of Alexander the Great. Architectural marvels are being discovered in Greece and Turkey, whilst in Egypt a skeleton with severe injuries has been found.
pr.sub: Lost Cities of Alexander the Great

pr.d: In the North, junior tow trucker Ole Henrik is sent by his father on a major solo mission. In the south, Thord heads out to rescue a carpenter's van, only to discover that he's come underprepared.
In 1979, a packed aircraft crashed into a trailer park community in Chicago only seconds after take-off. The accident claimed 273 lives.
June 24, 1982: During a calm flight to Australia, smoke starts filling the cabin with a passenger jet. The terrifying flight volcanoes can affect passenger jets.

Jo Roger's crew risk defeat when their towing gear shatters in extreme cold. Bjoern's called out to recover a stranded car after two tourists stray onto a ski track, and Thord gets angry when a truck driver ignores his advice.
Frozen planes, an injured flight attendant, and a drunk trespasser keep the team on their toes as the big freeze hits Toronto International Airport.

pr.t: Surviving Alaska: Women of the Wild
pr.d: Four Alaskan women embark on a winter of adventure and survival.
After clearing the Manx2 Flight 7100 for landing, controllers at Ireland's Cork Airport are shocked when it goes into a severe roll, crashing into the runway.
Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.
Shortly after taking off from Shanghai, Korean Air Flight 6316 disappears from radar and slams into a residential neighbourhood. Investigators from China, South Korea, and the US join forces.
Some of the deadliest air crashes in history have been caused by simple misunderstandings, and it's a tiny error in the cockpit that brought tragedy to Quincy Airport in Illinois.

The Petrel team searches for the American aircraft carrier USS Hornet. The Doolittle Raid was launched off her deck to avenge Pearl Harbour. But six months later, the ship's life was cut short when the Hornet sailed into Japanese ships.
Master mechanic Fuzz Townshend and Tim Shaw are restoring some much-loved automobiles to their former glory.

Investigate a tomb in Naples that may contain a prince who inspired the legend of Dracula. Read the desperate letters of Jewish rebels hidden in an Israeli cave, tour a 6,000-year-old labyrinth in Malta, and see the oldest human burial in Africa.
Revealing how 273 people were killed when American Airlines Flight 191 lost its left engine in the deadliest aviation accident in US history.

These dogs will delight and surprise as they play, cuddle and bond with their best friends of all shapes and sizes.
The Docs at Critter Fixer take a trip back to their alma mater to help a cow that is separated from her herd.
Simon has his hands full with a massive black mamba that does not want to be caught, a cobra hiding in a room of old sacks, and a snake in a car.

The team investigate a flurry of shark bites suddenly occurring off the coast of Long Island. Their investigation will call upon local experts who have noticed changes around the time the bites began. And with sand tiger sharks likely responsible for the bites, Diva takes a dive with them in search of some answers.
After the murder of one of their own, the Makulu Pack of Wild Dogs look to a new leader for salvation. The Western Pride is exiled to the fringes of the Kingdom as they fight to protect their cubs.
The Schroeders struggle to help an underweight puppy put on pounds.

A new class starts at Panda School. Little cubs who spent their whole lives in the maternity unit venture outside for the first time into a world full of new sights, new sounds and new Panda Skills to learn.
The Kinabatangan River flows through an area of diverse environments where leopards stalk primates and flying snakes perform death-defying leaps.

Stanley discovers surprises in this wild region he has never visited before; he investigates how the rugged terrain influences the food and culture; high in sheep country, he prepares mutton on a traditional barbecue.
Going behind the scenes when customs stops the smuggling of lethal drugs, and a passenger misses his father's funeral.
Dr. Oakley treats a limping bison and a litter of puppies struggling to survive.
Triumph turns to concern after the historic birth of red wolf pups.

Aardvarks Willie and Peanut go on a blind date that could ultimately produce the park's first-ever aardvark babies; a black rhino undergoes a blood draw; a massive Nile crocodile gets a checkup for his injured tail.

Peri the porcupine is about to give birth to a fuzzy new baby; Anala, a Sumatran tiger, faces a series of challenging tests to keep her mentally and physically stimulated; Dugan, a southern white rhino, enjoys a birthday party.
In the canopies of the Costa Rican jungle, the prey fights to escape the death that stalks the forest floor. But monsters do not play by the rules.
The residences of Port Protection build a life changing tool.

Phil Breslin ventures into Australia's notorious swamp country, where he encounters the speedy freshwater crocodile, the predatory barramundi, and the world's largest reptile, the saltwater crocodile.

Today is the grown-ups' singing competition at the theatre and the kids are the judges. The children jump up and down and sing along. Everybody loves singing.
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first.
Mr Bull arrives with his team to start work on Peppa's house renovation. Peppa and family move into the caravan in the garden while the work is being completed.
Madame Gazelle gets the playgroup to play music - with instruments that they must make themselves.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog to visit Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse. Grampy Rabbit knows all about the sea, and can make a lot of noise too, which is useful.
It is raining outside so Peppa and George have to stay indoors. While they wait for the rain to stop, Daddy Pig teaches them a fun game.
It's all play and not much work when Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office.
Peppa and her friends are going camping. Madame Gazelle, their teacher, is in charge. First they put up their tents. Then they collect sticks to make a campfire.
Gerald Giraffe is new to playgroup! He's trying to make friends with Peppa and the group, but finds being so tall is making playing hide and seek quite a challenge.
Mummy and Daddy Pig, Peppa and George have a wonderful day with Mr. Potato at Digger World.
George finds a very friendly spider in the bathroom. Peppa doesn't like spiders and screams very loudly. But soon she realises that the little spider doesn't want to hurt her.
Peppa's French friend Delphine Donkey comes to stay. Peppa takes Delphine to playgroup where they teach her the 'Bing Bong Song'.
Mummy Pig gives her old computer to Granny and Grandpa Pig. They use it for lots of important work - as well as Happy Mrs Chicken. But who will fix it when it breaks.
Peppa and her friends go to help at Edmond Elephant's birthday party, but the little children are harder to look after than they'd thought.
Granny and Grandpa Pig have a new pet parrot, Polly. Peppa and George teach Polly how to grunt like a noisy little piggy.
Peppa and George have to tidy up their bedroom. Daddy and Mummy Pig help, and soon the room is tidy - but not for long.
Daddy Pig hangs his clean football shirt out to dry, but Peppa, George and Mummy splash it with mud. They put it in the wash, but Peppa puts her red dress in, which makes Daddy's shirt pink.
Doctor Hamster visits the school and brings some animals with her. Binky the tortoise is very popular - but ends up needing to be rescued by Miss Rabbit.
Peppa and her family collect apples and blackberries in Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden to make a pie.
Madame Gazelle is getting Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music.
Peppa and George go behind the scenes to find out how TV is made when Miss Rabbit shows them around the set of Super Potato's TV show.
Mummy and Daddy Pig show Peppa and George how to play flying discs in the park. Soon their friends appear with their parents.
Peppa celebrates Goldie's birthday by holding an undersea party - by turning the house into an underwater environment.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.

Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the skate park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. While Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard, she soon learns that he is more of an expert than she realised.
Mr Labrador is here in his new ice cream van. It is his first day selling ice creams. In fact, Mr Labrador loves ice cream, perhaps a little too much.

Granny and Grandpa Pig have been growing strawberries to make jam, but the birds have eaten all the fruit. They decide to go and pick their own at Miss Rabbit's strawberry farm, but Granny and Grandpa eat too many strawberries and end up very full.
Peppa and her friends visit the Little Cars Play Centre where Miss Rabbit is in charge, and they get to drive little toy cars.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They hide in it during a snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and also Peppa's igloo.
The children learn about the weather, there is a new friend for Peppa, and Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's where Grandpa Pig is making a Rock Garden.
Mandy Mouse has a birthday visit to a cheese theme park with Peppa and her friends. Everything in the park is cheese-themed, and Mandy loves cheese.
Inspired by Granny Pig's stories of ancient Rome, Peppa and George decide to design the mosaic of a dinosaur with pebbles, and learn a little Latin.
Peppa and her family have gone on holiday, staying in a teeny tiny little holiday home near the beach. They discover that even when it rains, they can have lots of fun.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleep-over, with different friends in each of the four different flats in the high street. They decide to play hide and seek across all the rooms.
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
While drawing pictures at playgroup, Peppa and her friends learn about each other's families, from Suzy sheep who lives with Mummy Sheep to Freddy Fox who lives with Mr. Fox.

While Mummy Pig is at work, Peppa, George and Daddy make the best out of not being able to use the computer by tidying the kitchen, and when they find a jelly mould, they decide to make a nice surprise for their busy mum.
Grandpa and Granny Pig dust off their motorbike and sidecar to take Peppa and George on a trip. They go to the beach and camp in a tent that folds out of the sidecar.
Peppa Pig and Suzy Sheep are spending the day with Doctor Hamster, and they are learning about what vets do. Doctor Hamster says she's glad to have two helpers with her and calls the next patient.
While at a playgroup with Madame Gazelle, Peppa and her friends learn all about the weather by building themselves a Weather Station, complete with thermometer, wind turbine and rain collector.
Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day; after a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds an art piece at Suzy's house.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandma, Peppa and George go to the shed to see what Grandpa is doing and discover that he's built a robot.

Mummy and Daddy take Peppa and George for a day out at the botanical gardens. Miss Rabbit is there to greet them and show them around. There's the hot house, the cold house, the rainforest garden and the laboratory where Mr Rabbit creates new varieties of flowers. Last of all, there is the children's garden, which has another water feature... mud!
Peppa and George are playing in the garden when they hear a strange noise. It's thunder. Peppa and George are a little bit frightened at first but Peppa soon decides that she loves thunderstorms.
Peppa and her family spot a rainbow when they go for a drive.
Peppa and her family are trying to get to the playground, but Mr Bull's roadworks are in the way.

Peppa and George's toy basket is full, and their beds are covered in toys, so Mummy Pig decides it is time to order a new toy cupboard. The cupboard arrives in the post, but it needs to be assembled - and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY. Luckily help is at hand, as Mr Zebra the Postman loves assembling flat-pack furniture.
Granny and Grandpa's pet Polly Parrot comes to stay, and Peppa and George love Polly Parrot. But when she flies away, no one knows what to do.
Grandpa Pig has built a fantastic little train called Gertrude, and when they take a ride, they give all their friends a ride.
When Peppa goes for a sleepover at Zoe Zebra's house with Suzy Sheep, Rebecca Rabbit, Candy Cat and Emily Elephant, the girls are too excited to go to sleep.
It's nighttime at Grandpa and Granny Pig's house, and Peppa and George have stayed up late to help hunt for slugs and snails. But what other night animals will they find?
Peppa and George make everyone laugh when they dress up as Mummy and Daddy Pig.
When Daddy Pig loses his glasses he gets a bit grumpy, but Peppa and George have lots of fun looking for them.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her friends on a train ride where they must tick off what they see on their activity sheets.
Peppa and family go on a walk through the forest where they meet all of their favourite fairytale characters. They visit the home of bears who like porridge and meet a hungry Mr Wolf.
Peppa and all her friends at playgroup dress up as different countries from all over the world.
Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden when they find a little snail.
Peppa and Suzy Sheep are best friends, but one day they have a quarrel over a game of cards and decide they are not best friends any more.
When the school roof is broken and needs fixing, Peppa volunteers Mummy Pig to do a parachute jump to raise money. Daddy Pig goes up too, and has to overcome his fear of heights.

Mummy Pig's book is finished, and it's time to show it off to Peppa and her playgroup friends. Unfortunately, Peppa and George lose some of the book when they are playing, and Mummy Pig has to think quickly to fix it.
Peppa and George love going to the beach on sunny days. They bring their water wings, a beach ball and buckets and spades. Peppa and George have fun burying Daddy Pig in the sand.
Peppa and George go on a boat trip with Grandpa Pig, but they must send Polly Parrot for help when their boat runs aground. Polly fetches Granny Pig and Grandad Dog to rescue them.
Peppa and her friends and family are looking forward to a trip to the seaside where they can make sandcastles, but when they arrive at the beach there is too much snow.
Mrs Zebra teaches Peppa, George, Zoe, Zaza and Zuzu Zebra how to make a real tea set from clay.
Madame Gazelle takes the class to London for the day, where they are given a tour of the city by none other than the Queen of England.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her school friends on a school bus trip to the mountains. From the top of the mountains, there is a fantastic view, and Peppa and her friends have fun hearing echoes.
Playgroup is having a pet competition and everyone has brought their pets. Dr Hamster is the judge, but it is so hard to choose the best pet.
Peppa and her friends play some very active games in the garden.
Madame Gazelle teaches the children how to play the recorder. They practise a lot at home, then put on a performance for all the parents to enjoy.
Peppa, George and Daddy Pig visit the charity shop to sell things they don't need, and things they may need.
Peppa and George play in their grandparents' garden on a very hot day, but they don't have a paddling pool; Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and even a water slide.
Mum, Dad, Peppa and George decide to go to the beach on a beautiful sunny day. Suddenly, a little cloud covers the sun for a minute, but then it passes and the sun reappears.
Peppa and Suzy are excited about the sleepover and sit up in bed talking about what they will do when they grow up.
The playgroup visits a nature reserve, specialising in tiny insects, bugs, and butterflies. So Pedro brings along his pet stick insect.
Mandy Mouse joins Peppa's playgroup. She uses a wheelchair and is super sporty. The children have a lot of fun playing together.
Peppa and her family enjoy the apple tree at the top of the hill. It has a swing on it that they all like to swing on and Peppa has a special song for it.
Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tour of an exercise park. Since the machines are only for grownups, the kids do funny exercises instead.
Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival, a jigsaw festival. Peppa learns the secrets of puzzles from Grandma Donkey.

Peppa and George are watching a television show about Detective Potato and how he helps people find things. Daddy needs to buy some gravel so Peppa and George go with him. They park the car in a very large car park, but when they return, they can't remember where they parked it. Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel arrive to help Daddy Pig but have no luck. Suddenly, Detective Potato appears and saves the day.
Peppa, George and Freddy Fox are mistaken for pirates while sailing on the river with Grandpa Pig. When the truth is revealed, officers Panda and Squirrel invite them for a ride in their police boat.
During a picnic in her garden, cousin Chloe shows Peppa and George fun things to do with flowers.
Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!
After finding out Daddy Pig has a place in the London Marathon, Peppa and George help Daddy Pig become stronger with lots of different, though not all typical, exercises.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.
Madame Gazelle needs to go to the dentist and Bull takes over Peppa's class. As the children already know the suggested themes, Bull decides to show them how to fix a floorboard that is creaking.

Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are going out for the evening. Granny and Grandpa Pig babysit Peppa and George. They are too excited to sleep. When Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig get home everyone is asleep.
Peppa and Luzie Locke find that adults have to work all the time. The children imitate the elders, in the shop and on the playground. They realise that playing can be really hard work.
Peppa and her friends learn how to count by playing games at Madame Gazelle's playschool.
Madame Gazelle gives the class a music lesson. There's lots of crashing and banging at first, but it's not long before the grown-ups visit and lay down some notes of their own.
George has fun making bubbles, and Peppa has fun popping them.
Suzy Sheep has come to play with Peppa, and has made up a pretend friend called 'Leo Lion'. Peppa can't see Leo, but Suzy announces that Leo likes roaring and playing dressing up.
It's Daddy Pig's birthday, but he has to go to work, so while he's away, Mummy Pig, Peppa and George prepare a special birthday surprise.
Daddy Pig is left behind when everyone takes Grampy Rabbit's little boat to the riverside picnic spot. Will someone remember him and save him some cake?
When Daddy Pig and Mummy Pig are tidying up the house, they happen to find an old box of musical instruments. George makes a loud sound with the Swiss horn.
Peppa and George love helping Mummy Pig work on her computer, but they like playing computer games more.
The youngsters visit the zoo where they are shown around by zookeepers Mr Lion, Mrs Crocodile and Mr Giraffe.
Peppa and George are helping Grandpa Pig to dig a new pond for his garden. While digging, they find hidden treasure so they go to see Mr Richard in the museum.
Dr Hamster's pet tortoise, Tiddles, once again gets stuck on top of a tree, but everyone in the rescue team finds it tough to get the tortoise down.
Peppa and her family are at the swimming pool. George is a little worried at first but is soon splashing happily with his friend Richard Rabbit.
Peppa and George are helping Granny and Grandpa Pig tidy their attic, but they have trouble deciding what to throw out because Granny and Grandpa want to keep everything.

It's a beautiful day but Peppa, George and Grandpa Pig are sitting inside watching the motor racing on the television. Granny Pig shoos them all outside to enjoy the sunshine. Inspired by the racing, Grandpa Pig builds George his own racing car.
Peppa and George visit Granny Pig, who is very excited about her new pet, a parrot called Polly.

Mummy Pig has a lovely new picture of Peppa and George, so Daddy Pig offers to put it up, but it's not as simple as Daddy Pig thought, and he makes a very big hole in the wall.
Goldie the fish does not look happy and is not eating her food. Peppa, George, and Mummy Pig take her on a bus trip to visit Dr Hamster the vet.

Peppa has a new pen pal, a little donkey from France named Delphine. Peppa receives letters from Delphine Donkey and speaks to her on the telephone. Although Peppa speaks English and Delphine speaks French, they discover that they love lots of the same things, especially jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
Granny Pig is really pleased with all the plastic gnomes and wishing well she's got for the garden. Peppa and George love them too, but Grandpa Pig wishes they would all disappear.
Mummy Dog surprises Captain Daddy Dog with a gift of a boat trip for his birthday, but when Peppa and the gang come along, the trip doesn't go to plan.

Mummy and Daddy Pig let Peppa and George put their coats on over their pyjamas and go outside to look at the stars. With the help of a telescope, Daddy Pig teaches Peppa and George how to find the North Star.

When a fishing trip goes wrong, leaving Grandpa Pig and Grampy Rabbit stranded on a desert island, Captain Daddy Dog is the only one able to save them. It makes him realise that he misses the sea after all.
Peppa loves secrets, so Mummy Pig makes her a special box to put secret things in.

Peppa's best friend, Suzy Sheep, comes to play at Peppa's house for the afternoon. Peppa won't allow George to join in. When Peppa and Suzy want to play doctors and nurses, George is delighted to be the patient.
Granny and Grandpa Pig come for a dinner party with Mummy and Daddy Pig. Peppa and George are too tired to go to bed until they are told a story.
Daddy Pig winds up the old cuckoo clock in Peppa and George's bedroom. When the clock strikes the hour, a wooden bird pops out, flapping its wings and singing 'Cuckoo'.
Daddy teaches the children how to play basketball, and it is not long before they are good enough to take on a much bigger team.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to play in the playground. On the way it starts to get foggy, and before long it becomes so foggy that they can't see anything.

The Detective introduces his new friend, the superhero Super Potato, who teaches children the importance of eating fruit and vegetables every day, and later helps the Detective out of a complicated situation.
Peppa and the Pig family attend a school fête. Peppa's favourite things at the fête are face painting, the balloons, and the bouncy castle.
Everyone in Peppa's town is excited to meet Mr Potato when he comes to open a new sports centre.
Peppa and George want to jump in muddy puddles, but Mummy tells them to go in the pool instead.
Peppa and George take a bin of vegetable peelings to Grandpa Pig's compost heap. Worms inside the bin turn the peelings into compost, which Granny and Grandpa use to help their plants grow.
Madame Gazelle sets the children a creative task of making masks. There are carrot masks, robot masks, and even pretty butterfly masks. The only thing missing is lots and lots of glitter.
Madame Gazelle takes the children to Grampy Rabbit's gym class, where they learn how to be real explorers.
Grandpa Pig is planting seeds to make a flower garden, but the birds keep eating them, so Peppa and George help Grandpa Pig to make a scarecrow, which stops the birds eating Grandpa's seeds.

Rock, Paper, and Scissors meet Henry Winkler in 'The Henry Winkler Episode', then in 'Paper Loves Potato', Paper starts dating Potato. (S3, ep 7)

Ghost of a Chance: The full Chaos Council gears up for all-out war in Ghost Hill. Shadow worries about leaving Nine to rebuild the prism. Sonic insists Nine is a friend. (S1, ep 16)

SpongeBob will mehr über die Wikinger herausfinden, aber keiner kann ihm so richtig helfen. Also schreibt er einen Brief an den lieben Wikinger. Patrick und SpongeBob verlassen kurz die Bootsfahrschule, um zu einer Autogrammstunde zu gehen.

Zufällig entsteht ein Krosser Hot Dog, der bei den Kunden so gut ankommt, dass der Krabbenburger verbannt wird, weshalb SpongeBob rebelliert. SpongeBob und Patrick finden ein altes Piratenschiff, das für Mr. Krabs eine willkommene Geldquelle ist.

Patrick and Squidina go undercover to investigate a corrupt novelty product factory. The Patrick Show presents the Roast of Patrick Star.
The campers meet two backwoods narwhals in 'Sugar Squeeze', then in 'Tag, You're It', On a rainy day, SpongeBob and his friends entertain themselves indoors with a turbulent game of tag.
Squidward is so tired that SpongeBob and Patrick are unable to wake him up, but they do not want him to miss his big audition. Mr Krabs and his crew cater a fancy party.
The monsters of camp host a support group in 'Calling Some Monsters', then in 'Dig This', a buried bone unearths a heap of trouble for Sandy.
Patrick inducts SpongeBob into his prestigious society of dullards and doofuses. Patrick takes his grime to a new extreme, playing around in so much rubbish that he becomes unrecognisable.
pr.sub: The Nitwitting; The Ballad of Filthy Muck

pr.d: Mr Krabs manufactures Krabby Patties on an industrial scale, but it drives a wedge between SpongeBob and Patrick.
A concert promoter wants to send SpongeBob and Squidward on the road until greedy Mr Krabs decides to manage them and their world tour himself.
Patrick loses the remote in the cushions, so journeys into the couch to find it in 'Lost in Couch', then in 'Pat-a-thon', Patrick hosts a telethon to raise money for snails who can't dance.

It's time to restock the secret Krabby Patty ingredient, and it is SpongeBob's duty to make sure the ingredient is delivered safely to the Krusty Krab. Plankton has a customer who eats at the Chum Bucket every day.
After Patrick eats life-threatening chum, SpongeBob helps him with his 'Chum Bucket List', then in 'Big Baby Patrick', Patrick devolves back into a baby so he can keep his childhood toys.

SpongeBob and Patrick try to help Sandy rid her Tree Dome of fleas. When Patrick accidentally takes SpongeBob's doughnut, he is wracked with guilt over his crime. SpongeBob battles a persistent speck of food that is on a plate.
pr.sub: A Flea in Her Dome; Donut of Shame; The Krusty Plate

Leonard sucht Paulines Nähe und bietet ihr an, ein Praktikum bei ihm in der Geschäftsführung zu machen, um sich in die Hotelleitung einzuarbeiten. Pauline zögert, doch sie sehnt sich nach Leonards Nähe. Leonard gesteht derweil Martin, dass auch er auf eine Versöhnung hofft. Als Friedrich Pauline in Anwesenheit eines Notars schließlich die 20 Prozent seiner Anteile überschreibt, erleidet er einen Schwächeanfall. Charlotte erwartet von Friedrich, dass er sich selbst anzeigt.

Barbara missfällt die neuerliche Annäherung zwischen Pauline und Leonard. Sie erinnert Leonard an seine Pflicht als werdender Vater, doch Leonard weist die Verantwortung für die Zwillinge zunächst harsch zurück - bis in ihm ungeahnte Vatergefühle erwachen, als er den Herzschlag seiner vermeintlichen Kinder hört. Pauline indes hadert mit sich, ob der Preis für ihr Glück mit Leonard nicht zu hoch ist, und trifft eine folgenschwere Entscheidung.

Leonard beteuert zwar, dass sich seine Gefühle geändert haben, als er im Krankenhaus die Herztöne seiner vermeintlichen Kinder gehört hat, doch Pauline glaubt ihm nicht. Auch behagt es ihr nicht, dass sie nun als Anteilseignerin noch viel mehr an den "Fürstenhof" und damit auch an Leonard gebunden ist. Als Charlotte Leonard erklärt, dass die Liebe allein manchmal nicht reicht, wenn die Basis einer Beziehung zerstört ist, schreibt er Pauline einen Brief, deren Zeilen sie mitten ins Herz treffen.

Ein Schuppen in der Schrebergartenkolonie ist Brandstiftern zum Opfer gefallen. Die Laubenpieper werden seit Monaten regelrecht terrorisiert. Einige Schrebergärtner, angeführt von dem streitbaren Werner Bauer, behaupten zu wissen, wer hinter den Anschlägen steckt: die neue Wirtin des Vereinsheimes, Dorothea Winninger. Seit sie hier lebt und arbeitet, ist es mit dem Frieden in der Kolonie dahin. Entsprechend aufgeheizt ist die Stimmung.

Die Wahrsagerin Madame Rubina prophezeit Julia, dass sie ihren Ex Sergej Raihmann schon bald wiedersehen werde - den Mann, der sie um 250.000 Euro betrogen hatte und mit Schulden und Baby Ellie vor einem Jahr hat sitzen lassen. Julia befragt die Wahrsagerin, weil sich der Unternehmer Gerhard Schaller von ihr betrogen sieht. Johannes wollte den lästigen Fall loswerden und auch Julia ist nicht begeistert von dieser Ermittlung.

Ben gibt Thomas bei dessen Auseinandersetzung mit Simone zwar recht, aber privat steht er zu Simone. Doch auch Ben hat mitbekommen, dass zwischen Simone und Eliane Spannungen herrschen. Simone leugnet das jedoch. Als aber Eliane eine Bluse nicht rechtzeitig für ihre Talkshow fertig hat, verliert Simone die Contenance und wird Eliane gegenüber rassistisch ausfällig. Ben ist schockiert. Lasse gibt keine Erklärung zu seiner Reaktion auf den Streit des Schlagerpaares.

Durch den Streit im Drei Könige wird Lasse an seine Vergangenheit erinnert. Er will sich ein paar Tage zurückziehen, um seine Gedanken zu ordnen. Nora ahnt, dass es in seinem Leben ein traumatisches Ereignis gegeben hat. Aber Lasse wurmt auch, dass Volker ständig um Nora herumscharwenzelt. Diesem Schnösel wird er Nora nicht überlassen! Ben ist geschockt von Simones rassistischer Äußerung über Eliane. Er stellt sich natürlich auf Elianes Seite und verlangt, dass Simone sich entschuldigt.

Schwester Arzu und Dr. David Engel haben eine schöne Zeit miteinander. Doch Arzu weiß nicht, wohin diese Liaison führen soll. Während David jeden Augenblick mit ihr genießt, ist sie vorsichtiger. Werden sie vielleicht ein Paar? Philipp Brentano lernt Tilmann Sachs und seine Freundin Judith Jansen kennen.

Hans-Peter Brenner arbeitet ehrenamtlich in einer Einrichtung für Obdachlose, im "Haus Lichtblick". Er ist fasziniert von der charismatischen Leiterin Gaby Ludwig, die die Einrichtung aufgebaut hat. Dort lernt Brenner den obdachlosen Herbert Stremann, genannt Gurke, kennen. Gurke wird nach einem Unfall, bei dem er sich am Kopf verletzt, in die Sachsenklinik eingeliefert. Nach der Wundversorgung will er die Klinik schon wieder verlassen, erleidet aber einen Zusammenbruch.
